records.claim: Miscarriage is common and can occur in any pregnancy for many different reasons. It is not known if olanzapine can increase the chance of miscarriage. Conditions, such as depression, can increase the chance of miscarriage. This makes it hard to know if a medication, the medical condition being treated, or other factors are increasing the chance of miscarriage.
